dog.description_text:
AGE / WEIGHT: 2 years old / 35 lbs

GENDER: Male

ENERGY: Moderate

GOOD WITH: Dogs - Yes, Kids - Yes, Cats - No

ABOUT ME: For about one second I'm cautious. Then my tail's going and I'm curious about everything you've got. I'm smart, alert, and once I pick my person, I'm all in. Toys? Not really my game. Walks and a good scratch? Now we're talking. I'm friendly with other dogs and particularly enjoy playmates closer to my size. I'm working on leash manners, but I learn fast.

MY FOSTER SAYS: "Given his size and temperament, he is so adoptable and I imagine he'll be snapped up quickly!"

HISTORY

From Georgia; came into a local shelter as a stray before being moved into a foster home with our rescue partner.

DETAILED PROFILE

Lamine Yamal is a smart, alert, entertaining young dog with a lot to say. When he wants something, he makes a funny little sound that's remarkably close to talking, and he'll keep the conversation going until you catch on. He's cautious for about a second with new people, then tail-wagging and curious.

He's still settling in, but his personality is coming through fast. Walks are his favorite thing, and a good scratch is a close second; toys don't do much for him. His energy is moderate and climbing, and he bonds closely with his people. He's found a good routine in foster and speaks up when it's time to go out.

He's friendly with other dogs, though bigger dogs' rowdier play can intimidate him. He's lived with kids. He needs a home without cats.

He's crate trained and house trained. Leash manners are his current project; he's an enthusiastic puller, so an adopter who enjoys training and long walks will make a great teammate.

Medium-sized, quick-witted, and full of charm, he has breakout-star potential written all over him.

MEDICAL HISTORY

The dogs in our care are up-to-date on vaccinations, spayed or neutered (when old enough), microchipped, and given a general health check. Immediate medical needs and medical history will be addressed with the adopter prior to adoption. Complete vet records will be sent shortly after adoption.
dog.name: Lamine Yamal
